text:
rachel: FYI we've got a customer report: toolcall + streaming truncation appears to create two confirmed ledger rows when the client reconnects through a cross-region router.

devin: can you paste the smallest trace?

rachel: pasted below (sanitized):
```
STREAM_START id=zz-900 model=gpt-s-2 seq=0
STREAM_CHUNK seq=1 tokens=32 data_prefix="Order"
TOOLCALL start id=tool-9 token_offset=0
TOOLCALL success id=tool-9 produced_tokens=12
STREAM_TRUNCATE reason=client_cancel
LEDGER provisional customer=acme tokens=44 note=stream_partial
RECONNECT via router=route-eu-2 session=zz-900-1
STREAM_CHUNK seq=2 tokens=10 data_prefix="Details"
LEDGER confirmed customer=acme tokens=54 note=resume_confirm
```

arun: so provisional 44 then confirmed 54 -> double billing? Looks like we wrote provisional and later another confirmed without absorbing provisional.
nate: could be because the reconnect hit eu-2 which didn't own the provisional tombstone (we use per-router in-memory ownership cache), and the resume flow issues a fresh confirm write rather than attach.
emily: that implies two gaps: (A) tenant-visible provisional state not surfaced to other routers, (B) confirm path doesn't try to find unconfirmed provisional entries unless session_ids match.
devin: proposal: extend internal streaming API so confirm ops can include continuity_token set by the router that created provisional rows. continuity_token is opaque, globally unique per provisional write; routers propagate it in headers on resume attempts. If present, ledger confirm tries to attach to that token first.
arun: internal API change OK, but need fallback when token absent (older routers/clients). We'll keep current behavior then try best-effort matching by (customer, prefix_hash, window).
nate: also add an idempotency key on confirm writes: hash(customer + continuity_token + token_count) so DB can dedupe at write-time. Use upsert semantics returning whether row was new or attached.
emily: telemetry + UX: Console needs a "pending billing" column and a drilldown listing provisional writes per workspace. Also make provisional rows linkable to traces. Ops need to mark provisional as disputed/refund.
rachel: add metric provisional.orphan.count and provisional.attach.latency. dashboard: time-series for orphaned provisionals, attach success rate, and confirmed_delta_histogram (confirmed - provisional).
devin: quota implications: provisional writes currently count against quota immediately. If provisional gets orphaned and then duplicated on confirm, customer gets double-charged and quota double-decrement. Maybe change to: provisional decrements a soft_quota metric; only confirmed decrements hard_quota. But that's a big UX change.
arun: agree big change. Alternative: provisional counts as billed for quota but mark them as reversible; if confirm attaches we don't change quota; if confirm is separate we only observe confirmed. Hard to reconcile. Need to talk to billing team.
emily: for rollout, feature-flag continuity_token support and idempotent confirm upserts. Start 0.1% traffic in canary, watch provisional.orphan.count, attach.rate, and incidents. Add a dashboard widget comparing quota usage vs invoice totals in canary vs control.
nate: implementation notes: provisional writes must persist continuity_token in provisional table with TTL 5m. Confirm writer does transactional attach: SELECT provisional WHERE continuity_token = X FOR UPDATE; if exists and not attached -> attach and mark attached_by=confirm_id; else proceed to create confirmed row only if no matching attached provisional found.
devin: watch performance impacts of FOR UPDATE; use short transactions and ensure index on continuity_token. Also add async reconcile job that scans provisionals older than TTL and tries fuzzy-match to confirmed to close gaps.
rachel: ops alert: page if provisional.orphan.count > 10 in 30m or if attach_rate < 80% for > 15m. Billing-bot will notify #support when orphan > 0 for paying customers.
ops-bot: billing-notify: orphan provisional detected for customer=acme count=1 trace=link-to-trace

emily: UX tweak: in Console, show "billing-state" badge with states: provisional, attached, confirmed, disputed. And add a small help doc explaining provisional lifecycle.
arun: can someone open the console + infra tickets? I'll own the backend DB changes.
devin: I'll PR the API change and the idempotent confirm logic. planning to include unit tests simulating cross-router resume.
nate: I'll prototype local simulator for router ownership races to validate the TTL heuristics.
emily: i'll draft the dashboard panels and the help doc.
rachel: thanks all. let's aim for a canary next week. ping me if a customer escalates.
